title.from: Keep VideoML effects independent of Babulus voiceover
title.to: Use VideoML visuals and voiceover independently of Babulus

description.from:
## Behavior
As a VideoML author, I can preview and render visual effects without a voice provider or Babulus account.

## Acceptance scenarios
Given a visual-only composition, when it is previewed and exported, then no TTS credentials or paid media service are required.
Given narration-related code in the extracted toolchain, when ownership is reconciled, then docs distinguish standard timing/cue semantics from Babulus voice synthesis and migration preserves Babulus behavior.

## Ownership
toolchain, specification, player, stdlib; consult Babulus

## Evidence
Link implementation, runnable fixtures, and verification results before closing. Keep product-boundary decisions in the parent initiative.
description.to:
## Behavior
VideoML authors can use visual effects alone or standard voiceover with open Auritus-backed local synthesis, without a Babulus account.

## Acceptance
Given a visual-only composition, when previewed or exported, no voice model/provider is required.
Given a narrated composition and a supported installed Auritus model, when generated locally, speech and timing require no paid provider or hosted rendering service.
Babulus-specific orchestration is optional; standard voiceover belongs in VideoML.
